observations.description: Redis password 'OTn1WGEUUNsLJDQ3xfokPcxVe75YgtbMdvoPKLzW' hardcoded in 3 test source files — exposed in version control and will persist in git history even if removed later
observations.recommendation: Mandatory REDIS_PASS env var with no default fallback in production; migrate to secrets manager (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or similar). Rotate the exposed credential immediately.

observations.description: Assertion 'relay.returncode is not None' is always True for any completed subprocess — it verifies nothing about relay success
observations.recommendation: Replace with 'relay.returncode == 0' to verify actual relay execution success

observations.description: Default REDIS_HOST='172.16.12.2' and REDIS_PASS='' hardcoded as silent fallback — if env vars are missing, system silently connects to wrong Redis or fails mysteriously
observations.recommendation: Fail-fast on missing required config in production: raise RuntimeError if REDIS_HOST or REDIS_PASS not set in non-test environments

observations.description: 'Sans effet externe': True hardcoded — no real assertion that task produces no side effects (no git changes, no file writes outside test/tmp, no network calls outside Redis)
observations.recommendation: Implement actual external effects verification: capture git status before/after, assert no new untracked files, assert no commits made

observations.description: STARTED state not explicitly checked in e2e test — only RECEIVED, ACCEPTED (tautological), COMPLETED are verified
observations.recommendation: Add explicit STARTED state check: verify task:<task_id> exists with state='STARTED' before COMPLETED, or verify log entries show processing start
